activity.notes: Brian Boru obtained the submission of Máel Sechnaill in 1002 and became High King of Ireland, remaining the dominant high king until his death at Clontarf in 1014. ATLAS uses 'High Kingship of Ireland' rather than a modern unitary Irish state label, preserving the layered and tributary nature of medieval Irish overkingship.

sources.title: Brian Boru's Fort — Heritage Ireland
sources.citation_text: Heritage Ireland identifies Brian Boru as High King from 1002 until his death in 1014.

sources.title: 'Emperor of the Irish': Brian Boru — Trinity College Dublin
sources.citation_text: Trinity College Dublin explains Brian's acquisition of supremacy by 1002 and the contemporary Book of Armagh styling him imperator Scotorum.
